name: Beef and Cauliflower Taco Skillet

fit.note: 464 cal is inside 400-650; 34g carbs clears the 35g ceiling with 1g margin on the source's published numbers; no seafood; skillet scales to 14 servings. FIT on published macros.

dupe_evidence: Not a duplicate. Closest catalog neighbors are loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls and tex-mex-beef-rice-skillet-bowls, but both are rice-based taco/Tex-Mex ground-beef skillets; this dish swaps the starch for riced cauliflower, which is the distinguishing low-carb plate the catalog lacks (no beef recipe among 138 uses cauliflower). Shares protein+flavor+method with loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls (3 of 4) but the starch swap genuinely distinguishes it for a low-carb run.
borderline_flag: Adjacent to loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls on protein+Tex-Mex flavor+skillet method; kept because the cauliflower-rice starch is the deliberate low-carb differentiator this run targets. Also carries a thin macro margin (34/35g carbs, 24g protein just under the catalog 25g identity) - a label-accurate recompute could push carbs over, worth the decider's eye.
cross_protein_collision: Would be structurally the same dish as a ground-turkey or ground-chicken cauliflower taco skillet (same riced-cauliflower + taco-seasoning + beans/cheese/avocado build). If another selector's pool holds a turkey/chicken cauliflower taco skillet, only one such plate should survive the cross-protein merge.
